items.title: Inside Cirro: Enumeration as a Restricted Guest

items.title: Master Key Included: Detecting SolarWinds ARM CVE-2026-28326
items.summary: A hardcoded authentication secret ships with every SolarWinds Access Rights Manager install, and reaching TCP 55555 is enough to hit a .NET deserialization sink. Bishop Fox confirmed SYSTEM-level code execution, breaks down the root cause, and shares a safe detection tool for defenders.
items.title_ru: В комплект входит мастер-ключ: обнаружение SolarWinds ARM CVE-2026-28326

Бишоп Фокс подтвердил выполнение кода на уровне СИСТЕМЫ, выявил основную причину и поделился безопасным инструментом обнаружения для защитников.

items.title: Java4Shell Flaw (CVE-2026-114938) Enables Pre-Auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and More
items.summary: A Java flaw called Java4Shell can let attackers without an account run their own code on Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak, and three other widely used applications, says Calif, the security research firm that disclosed it this week. The flaw is present in Java 17.0.6 and later, and the vulnerable code runs…
